entries.1df0ce93a56506e3: This business provides cold storage of seafood and related services. Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd. leases the company’s Toyosu and Toyomi cold storage facilities and conducts cold storage operations, and Tsukiji Kigyo Co., Ltd. handles cargo handling inside those cold storage facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,466 million.
entries.1fdded76552c8de0: A company that, as a consignee at the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market (Toyosu Market), focuses on wholesaling marine products and also operates a cold storage warehouse business and a real estate leasing business.
entries.2b443ef43b21e01f: Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd. leases the company’s Toyosu Toichi Cold Storage and Toyomi Toichi Cold Storage facilities and conducts cold storage operations and related services.
entries.30c8c6d28e68612c: Segment information and related information are based on net sales to external customers by reportable segment, and on the regional and major customer information in the related information.
entries.4139158091671b18: Revenue from processing and sales of marine products
entries.41d0e3f122e8a054: This business is conducted by Tsukiji Kigyo Co., Ltd., which performs cargo handling within the cold storage facilities of Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.4522718dbb3b183d: Businesses that require storage of marine products
entries.47dbd62c34409a52: The company and 7 subsidiaries form the group, and the consolidated subsidiaries are 4 companies: Tōichi Logistics Co., Ltd., Kyōdō Suisan Co., Ltd., Kitashoku Co., Ltd. and Tsukiichi Suisan Co., Ltd. Consolidated employees number 292 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.47e16fe7e5f2b00a: It is a business model based at Toyosu Market that collects fresh, frozen and processed marine products and sells them to intermediate wholesalers and mass retailers, and also earns revenue from refrigerated storage and real estate leasing.
entries.4a379ceb3f99db57: Intermediate wholesalers and mass retailers as customers
entries.55152c3c1574d323: Kyodo Suisan Co., Ltd. sells fresh and frozen seafood, and products it processes in-house, to department stores, hotels, restaurants and others with tenant outlets, and Kitashoku Co., Ltd. processes and sells fresh and frozen seafood in Ishikari City, Hokkaido.
entries.5e9ede7c7de465d7: This business is conducted by Tsukiji Kigyo Co., Ltd., which performs cargo handling within the cold storage facilities of Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd.
entries.650b23edfc3f6233: Under this business, the company receives consignments from shippers to sell fresh and processed seafood at the Toyosu Market, and also purchases and sells such products itself.
entries.6a64ac4a37b96f52: Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd. leases the company’s Toyosu Toichi Cold Storage and Toyomi Toichi Cold Storage facilities and conducts cold storage operations and related services. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8917536a40d7c754: Kyodo Suisan Co., Ltd. sells fresh and frozen seafood, and products it processes in-house, to department stores, hotels, restaurants and others with tenant outlets, and Kitashoku Co., Ltd. processes and sells fresh and frozen seafood in Ishikari City, Hokkaido. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8e2fabc86234f50e: Marine products are sold to intermediate wholesalers, mass retailers such as department stores and supermarkets, and business customers such as hotels and restaurants. Refrigerators are used by businesses that require storage of marine products.
entries.8efa6fc55e3e1c63: In the core marine product wholesale business, the company conducts consignment sales and purchase sales of fresh and processed marine products at Toyosu Market, and its subsidiaries handle processing and sales and intermediate wholesale sales. It also operates refrigerated warehousing and real estate leasing as ancillary businesses.
entries.9400418f4715432a: Revenue from the refrigerated warehousing business, such as cold storage
entries.a6748f3fc85747fd: This business leases real estate and conducts related activities. Part of the real estate owned by the company and Kyodo Suisan Co., Ltd. is leased to external parties and to companies in the company’s group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥151 million.
entries.a6d23e3f16c8392f: Revenue from the real estate leasing business
entries.baf579f04b5cb228: This business leases real estate and conducts related activities.
entries.c01be4441c85f4a2: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥386 million.
entries.c14a386363ade7a7: This business wholesales seafood and its processed products. The company conducts consignment sales and purchase sales of fresh and processed seafood, Kyodo Suisan Co., Ltd. and Kitashoku Co., Ltd. process and sell fresh and processed seafood, and Tsukiji Ichikawa Suisan Co., Ltd. conducts intermediate wholesale sales at the Toyosu Market. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥65,833 million, the largest of the 3 reportable segments.
entries.c8cad35fb5d619fd: As a receiving company (uke-kaisha) of the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market under the Wholesale Market Act, it states that it fulfills the social mission of “contribution to the healthy dietary lives of the people” and aims to achieve “a shift from a traditional-type receiving company to a sales company with broad functions.” Its medium-term management plan, “MF-2026 (Move Forward 2026),” covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, identifies as priorities expanding the handling of fresh marine products, strengthening the processing, manufacturing and sales of frozen marine products, strengthening processing in production and consumption areas, and improving logistics efficiency, and it states that it will work on increasing the handling of marine products that consider the protection of marine resources and the environment, enhancing processing in production and consumption areas, and utilizing facilities such as refrigerators within Toyosu Market. Numerical targets of the plan are forward-looking matters and are not transcribed here.
entries.cfba7311ab5fd7f9: Group of the company and 7 subsidiaries
entries.d23006a41d67030c: Of consolidated revenue of ¥67,450 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥65,833 million for the marine product wholesale business, which accounts for the bulk, ¥1,466 million for the refrigerated warehousing business, and ¥151 million for the real estate leasing business. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.df05051c02d69281: This business is conducted by Tsukiji Ichikawa Suisan Co., Ltd., which operates as an intermediate wholesaler at the Toyosu Market of the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market and sells frozen, dried and salted, and fresh seafood, and processed products of these. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.df09a5f38fab4b71: This business provides cold storage of seafood and related services.
entries.e0a6cd70cb9d7fed: Business customers such as hotels and restaurants
entries.e3585d9cabf53a8d: This business is conducted by Tsukiji Ichikawa Suisan Co., Ltd., which operates as an intermediate wholesaler at the Toyosu Market of the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market and sells frozen, dried and salted, and fresh seafood, and processed products of these.
entries.e7894d840521d25d: This business wholesales seafood and its processed products.
entries.e9c88bc7caa50e85: Mass retailers such as department stores and supermarkets
entries.f1fd3c3ff075edd8: As a central wholesale market receiving company, it explains that it has functions to collect large volumes of many varieties of fresh food from domestic and overseas sources, to distribute them in small lots of many varieties, and to form prices through methods such as auctions. Toyosu Market is an enclosed facility with strengthened temperature control and quality and hygiene management, and it has multi-function refrigerators and processing facilities within the market; the company states that it strives to use these for collection and sales. It also states that, drawing on its ISO22000 certification, an international standard for food safety management systems, it implements hygiene management based on HACCP concepts.
entries.f6090fbc3386182c: Under this business, the company receives consignments from shippers to sell fresh and processed seafood at the Toyosu Market, and also purchases and sells such products itself. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.f89795d477a0bbb2: 3 businesses, centered on marine product wholesale
entries.fc094d40994e6f2e: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥67,450 million, up from ¥62,414 million in the previous consolidated fiscal year. Revenue from external customers was ¥65,833 million for the marine product wholesale business, ¥1,466 million for the refrigerated warehousing business, and ¥151 million for the real estate leasing business.
